# NutSplit
> Telegram bot for shared expenses. AI receipt scanning, balances, budgets, settlements.

## Pages
- [Bean — Running Tab That Settles Itself](https://www.nutsplit.com/): the modern front door; tracks a running tab among roommates, couples, and travel buddies.
- [NutSplit Docs](https://www.nutsplit.com/docs/): documentation for the Telegram expense-splitter bot.
- [Bean Landing](https://www.nutsplit.com/landing/): alternative landing for the Bean app.
- [Bean Pro](https://www.nutsplit.com/pro/): upgrade page for Pro features.

## Key facts
- Bot: https://t.me/NutSplitBot
- Built by a solo founder; primary surface is Telegram.
- Pages deployed via Netlify; the bean landing is at /, /landing/, /pro/, /moodboard/.
- Languages: English.
